title: The degree-zero closed-fibre derived-unit germ is the local-acyclicity map
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an abelian etale sheaf on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ and $t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega'\to S_{(s)}$ geometric points [def-weil-geometric-point, def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Put $p:X'=X\times_SS_{(s)}\to X$ and let $i:X_s\to X'$ and $h:X_t\to X'$ be the canonical fibre projections [def-pc-fibre-product, lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-functoriality]. Write $K=p^{-1}G[0]$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image] and let $\beta:K\to Rh_*h^{-1}K$ be the actual bounded-below derived-adjunction unit [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction, def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. At any geometric $z$ of $X_s$, put $x=p\circ i\circ z$ and let $a$ be the $z$-stalk of $\mathcal H^0(i^{-1}\beta)$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. There exist an isomorphism $e:S_{(s)}\simeq S_{(f\circ x)}$, an isomorphism $A$ from the source of $a$ to $G_x$, and an isomorphism $B$ from the target of $a$ to $\Gamma(V_{f,x,e\circ t},G|_V)$ [def-weil-pbc-global-sections-functor], such that $B\circ a=\alpha_{G,x,e\circ t}\circ A$ [def-weil-pbc-local-acyclicity-abelian-sheaf]. Here $G|_V$ is inverse image along $V_{f,x,e\circ t}\to X_{(x)}\to X$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. No local acyclicity hypothesis is imposed. This equality compares the actual morphisms, rather than merely their source and target objects.

proof.text: Normalize degree-zero homology of the actual derived unit by the generic derived-adjunction single-zero theorem. Commute the inverse image along i with homology and apply the geometric stalk functor. Compose the source single-homology isomorphism and the target normalization with the isomorphisms from the ordinary closed-fibre unit-germ comparison. Naturality of exact-inverse-image homology moves the derived unit through these isomorphisms. The generic normalization equation and the ordinary germ equation then give the stated actual-morphism equality.

theorem closedFibre_derivedUnit_zero_stalk_comparison
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    {Ω' : Type u} [Field Ω'] [IsAlgClosed Ω']
    (t : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s)
    {Ξ : Type u} [Field Ξ] [IsAlgClosed Ξ]
    (z : Spec (.of Ξ) ⟶
      pullback (pullback.snd f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Scheme.strictHenselizationPointEvaluation s)))) :
    let p := pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)
    let f' := pullback.snd f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)
    let i := pullback.fst f' (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Scheme.strictHenselizationPointEvaluation s)))
    let h := pullback.fst f' t
    let x := (z ≫ i) ≫ p
    let K := (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} p).obj G)
    let β := (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h).derivedPlus.unit.app K
    let a := (Scheme.pointSmallEtale z).sheafFiber.map
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ 0).map
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map β))
    ∃ e : Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s ≅ Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme (x ≫ f),
      ∃ A : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale z).sheafFiber.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)) ≅
          (Scheme.pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.obj G,
        ∃ B : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale z).sheafFiber.obj
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ 0).obj
              ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
                (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙
                  (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h).rightDerivedFunctorPlus).obj K))) ≅
            (Sheaf.Γ (localAcyclicityFiber f x (t ≫ e.hom)).smallEtaleTopology
              AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
              ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
                (pullback.fst (localAcyclicityStrictMap f x) (t ≫ e.hom) ≫
                  Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap x)).obj G),
          a ≫ B.hom = A.hom ≫ localAcyclicityAlpha f x (t ≫ e.hom) G
